// scenario for strings_splitafter_two_index_one_cut: `strings.SplitAfter(...)[1]` when only the second segment is needed.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.
func scenario665Positive(s, sep string) string {
	return strings.SplitAfter(s, sep)[1]
}
